post.summary: Query current scoped records with explicit continuation
post.description: Requires memory_read. Case-insensitive substring over primary/secondary/context; exact type/tag filters. UUID ordering, 1,000 results and 10,000 scanned entries per request. Live pagination is not a snapshot or changes feed. No synthetic similarity scores.
